opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 co-sponsored (Scheme B); up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C: PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences and non‑UK members for UK conferences; one grant per two years for Schemes B/C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics‑related conferences (Society‑organised meetings, other meetings, and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is in the UK; students need a supervisor letter; members must have been Society members for at least one year (if not a student).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short formal training courses or collaborative lab visits for genetics/genomics techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK; students need supervisor letter; one grant per research group per year; one grant per individual per two years.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and limited equipment for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Sponsorship

amount.raw: Typically £1,000–£2,000; larger sponsorships possible up to several thousand pounds

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society may apply at any time; applications should be submitted at least three months before the event and include a budget and diversity statement.
opportunities.summary: Supports sponsorship of genetics‑themed meetings not directly organised by the Society, covering venue, speaker travel, accommodation and related costs.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society; grants may be used for travel (UK only, economy) and materials for public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) that communicate genetics to the public.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups wishing to run regular genetics‑research meetings may apply; applications should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting and include a funding proposal.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £2,000 per year to support regular meetings of genetics research communities (Special Interest Groups) based in or strongly linked to the UK.
